Third-party software

FFmpeg 9.1
Copyright (c) 2000–2026 the FFmpeg developers.
Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard.

This converter uses a separately compiled FFmpeg command-line program
to decode samples of each converted disc during verification. The
program is bundled as a resource and launched as a separate process.
The build enables the MJPEG decoder and omits GPL and nonfree options.

Save FFmpeg Source exports the complete corresponding release source
with the exact build command and upstream release signature.
Upstream project: https://ffmpeg.org/
Licensing: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz

libjpeg-turbo 3.2.1
The native encoder uses libjpeg-turbo to keep quality settings
consistent with the tested ares discs. The applicable IJG, BSD-style,
and zlib license notices are reproduced below.
Upstream: https://libjpeg-turbo.org/

MMI and QON utilities
The encoder uses MIT-licensed ZIP64, QON, QOI2 and LaserDisc VBI
utilities from MukiEX's mmidsc, revision 1d812165429f7914c734f17ce4e3c947e668225a.
Local changes add Unicode filenames and Motion JPEG conversion.
QON and QOI2 are by Roger Sanders and Dominic Szablewski.
Please see the license and copyright headers in the solution's Native folder.
https://github.com/MukiEX/MegaCD_MiSTer/tree/1d812165429f7914c734f17ce4e3c947e668225a/tools/mmidsc/src
